firmware.note: RF Hackers Sanctuary's kitsune foxes (Wi-Fi AP/client, BLE iBeacon, Bluetooth Classic, Zigbee) are PlatformIO/Arduino firmware whose configuration is compiled in from a per-conference header. kitsune belongs to its authors (https://github.com/rfhs/kitsune); nothing of it is included here. Today the page prepares and checks that configuration and exports the header; flashing from the page comes later.
firmware.envs_note: kitsune's PlatformIO environments for this board (platformio.ini of each project, at the pinned commit), mapped to this page's templates and tiers; tools/build_kitsune.py builds these when the CI job is enabled, the firmware card offers the manifest's images for the selected template
